qualification_limits: One source, five related concise questions, one seed, one fresh process per arm on each host
Parent includes two prior natural training turns and model responses, while fresh arm sees raw policy text once; states and actual output lengths differ across arms
Fresh policy is sent only on first question, not repeated for every question
Native phase buckets contain operator/resource/wait costs; higher long-KV decode wall does not by itself identify attention arithmetic or page traffic
Parent construction time and cold page-cache state are not included in HTTP wall; parent import is recorded separately
Positive-temperature sampled route; configured NFQ/X are not physical engagement evidence
This is a matched within-arm cross-platform exactness proof for these requests, not a universal backend certification
